role: §1983 defendants — law enforcement officers who deprived steward of custody (liberty interest in parent-child relationship) without due process
theory_of_liability: Officers responded to Ann Hillberg's 911 call on June 16, 2023 and removed Cole from father's custody without verifying the custody order. A parent's liberty interest in the care and custody of their child is among the oldest fundamental rights recognized by the Supreme Court (Troxel v. Granville, 530 U.S. 57 (2000)). Removal without verification of custody status violates clearly established due process.
immunity_analysis: Officers will assert qualified immunity (Harlow v. Fitzgerald, 457 U.S. 800 (1982)). To overcome: must show (1) a constitutional violation occurred, and (2) the right was clearly established at the time. The right of a custodial parent to not have their child seized without due process is clearly established. A reasonable officer would know to check custody status before removing a child from a parent's home.
